proposition: None of the later papers read mentions the removal of the Turka family to Temür's court at Samarkand in 1387 or the c. 1387-93 Samarkand years. They begin his career abroad in Cairo (Sensorium, Grammatology) or with the youthful travels described in his own Mafāḥiṣ prologue (Prologue); the friendship with Qāżīzāda Rūmī from childhood (Timurid-Mughal, New Brethren) is not located. Samarkand appears in those papers only as the observatory. This is a statement about the pages read and searches of the rest.
